value.rationale: The first two sharp constants quantify instability of a canonical fixed-degree L2 polynomial projection as its Jacobi/Gegenbauer weight concentrates, contrasting bounded central Gaussian behavior with linearly growing worst-case endpoint amplification. The order-one coefficient and eventual uniqueness of worst-case evaluation points are nontrivial refinements beyond a standard local Hermite limit; they are useful for weighted least-squares stability and selecting evaluation locations. No unsupported higher-degree or global-in-a phase diagram is claimed.
